class_name: 過去-回想-ニキマッテイタ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

glosses: was bound to; was sure to
patterns.usage_note: Retrospective 〜に決まってた looks back and declares the outcome a foregone conclusion — 'obviously it would'. It voices the speaker's own conviction rather than evidence-based inference, so it is blunter than 〜はずだった. In real Japanese it also follows nouns and adjectives (嘘に決まってた, 高いに決まってた), but the attachment licensed here is a plain dictionary-form verb; 〜てた is the casual contraction of 〜ていた, and 〜に決まっていました is its polite counterpart.

examples.ruby: あんなに練習[れんしゅう]したんだから、勝[か]つに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: After all that practice, of course they were going to win.

examples.ruby: そんな嘘[うそ]、すぐばれるに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: A lie like that was bound to come out right away.

examples.ruby: 準備[じゅんび]もせずに挑[いど]んだんだから、失敗[しっぱい]するに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: Going in with no preparation at all, of course it was going to fail.
